listing.name: MDK / SDL engine (nemo22)
listing.summary: Explore MDK / SDL engine (nemo22) and follow the upstream project for requirements, downloads and setup.

steps.title: Prepare your original game
steps.instruction: Keep your own original MDK installed in a supported default GOG or Steam location; the player detects it. If it is elsewhere, follow upstream’s Running instructions to create mdk_paths.cfg beside mdk_sdl.exe and name the original folder in its [paths] mdk setting. The original files stay external and are read at runtime. The ZIP contains the native player and SDL3.dll; no game compilation or separate installer is required.

presentation.manual_preparation: Keep your own original MDK installed in a supported default GOG or Steam location; the player detects it. If it is elsewhere, follow upstream’s Running instructions to create mdk_paths.cfg beside mdk_sdl.exe and name the original folder in its [paths] mdk setting. The original files stay external and are read at runtime. The ZIP contains the native player and SDL3.dll; no game compilation or separate installer is required. Default settings.cfg, saves, mods and normal mdk-*.bmp captures live beside the player and are declared for compatible replacement and backup, along with the remembered mdk_paths.cfg. The original game remains external. If that directory is not writable, upstream uses AppData/mdk-sdl; MDK_USER_DIR and that external fallback remain outside backups. Optional locally generated texture mods/upstream upscaler tools belong to the declared mods folder, not the immutable player. Custom exported assets/captures and changed runtime files can use external registration. Runtime rollback carries current declared data, without rewinding saves or guaranteeing older-runtime compatibility. Existing external installations keep their files and runtime owner. Source/package inspection is separate from original-input, gameplay, minimum-environment and packaged Desktop acceptance observations.
